استقرئت (form X)

# اُسْتُقْرِئْتَ (ustuqriʔta) /us.tuq.riʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# اُسْتُقْرِئْتِ (ustuqriʔti) /us.tuq.riʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# اُسْتُقْرِئَتْ (ustuqriʔat) /u
